domain_restrictions: n is an integer with n > 1
t is real and satisfies (n - 1) / n <= t
t is real and satisfies t < 1
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For every integer n with n > 1, for every real t with (n - 1) / n <= t < 1, and for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n, the floor of k times t equals k minus 1.
quantifier_order: for all integers n with n > 1
for all real numbers t with (n - 1) / n less than or equal to t and t less than 1
for all integers k with 1 less than or equal to k and k less than or equal to n

variables.name: n
variables.role: primary parameter controlling the range of t and the range of k

variables.name: t
variables.role: real input restricted by a lower bound depending on n and by an upper bound

variables.name: k
variables.role: index parameter constrained between 1 and n, appearing inside the floor function

witness_dependencies: There are no existential witnesses; the claim is entirely universal over n, t, and k.
The allowed values of t depend on n through the lower bound (n - 1) / n.

statement_nl: For every integer n>1 and every real number t with (n-1)/n <= t < 1, one has floor(k*t) = k-1 for every integer k with 1 <= k <= n.
